title: Zebra holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M72 30 Q76 45 68 60' stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <polygon points='70,35 74,35 72,39' fill='#c9184a'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='17' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <!-- zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='62' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M28 58 Q33 52 30 48' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M34 64 Q38 56 35 52' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42 66 Q46 58 43 54' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 64 Q54 56 51 52' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M56 58 Q60 52 57 48' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='70' width='6' height='18' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='38' y='71' width='6' height='17' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='48' y='71' width='6' height='17' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='70' width='6' height='18' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='27' y='85' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='37' y='85' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='85' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='55' y='85' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M58 55 Q66 46 64 38' stroke='#f2f2f2' stroke-width='10' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='36' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='39' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#d9d9d9'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='62,28 64,20 67,27' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <polygon points='63,26 64,22 66,26' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <polygon points='70,28 72,20 74,27' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <polygon points='71,26 72,22 73,26' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M60 30 Q57 26 58 32' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M62 34 Q58 31 58 37' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- face stripes -->
  <path d='M63 33 Q61 36 63 39' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M67 30 Q66 34 68 36' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='34' r='2' fill='#2b2b5e'/>
  <circle cx='68.7' cy='33.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- raised hoof holding string -->
  <rect x='62' y='52' width='6' height='9' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0' transform='rotate(-25 65 56)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 58 Q15 55 16 60' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
</svg>
